plugin.name: Call of Cthulhu Fusion Fix
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the fix menu language. Auto uses English. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restores the settings on this plugin page.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply these settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then confirm to apply it.
FOVFactor.description: Multiply the ordinary gameplay field of view, up to 150 degrees across. Aiming, scripted views, camera effects and transitions keep their native framing. 1.0 uses the intended field of view.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a centered framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the current monitor resolution. Restart the game to apply.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup logo, legal and warning video playlist. Story and bonus videos remain available. Restart the game to apply.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause gameplay when switching away from the game. Off keeps gameplay running; native focus and keyboard handling remain active.
CutsceneBorders.description: Cutscenes are framed as a 16:9 picture. Both keeps that picture at any screen shape with bars around it; Letterbox adds bars only above and below, Pillarbox only at the sides; Off fills the screen with the wider gameplay view.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. The game is made for 60; higher frame rates can upset its physics and timing.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and shows it here. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
